strings.name: Shiv Nadar
strings.summary: Nadar and his partners built HCL from Indian computer hardware into global software services. He gradually left daily listed-company leadership, handing the chair to his daughter Roshni and becoming chairman emeritus and strategic adviser. His foundation established SSN and Shiv Nadar University and supports schools, scholarships and research. Its spending and impact figures remain institutional self-reports.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded HCL and helped develop India’s computer and software-services industries, with sustained involvement in higher education and training.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Pre-university studies at American College, Madurai; electrical engineering at PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From hardware to IT services
strings.highlights.h1.text: Cofounded HCL and supported its expansion from computers into software services.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Building educational institutions
strings.highlights.h2.text: Supported engineering colleges, a research university and education for rural students through his foundation.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Foundation reported investment
strings.timeline.t1.text: The foundation reported US$1.83 billion invested by March, reaching about 57,000 students and alumni.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Became chairman emeritus
strings.timeline.t2.text: Left HCLTech’s managing-director role while retaining emeritus and strategic-adviser titles.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Handed over the chair
strings.timeline.t3.text: His daughter Roshni Nadar Malhotra became HCLTech chair.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Research university established
strings.timeline.t4.text: The foundation opened Shiv Nadar University in Delhi NCR for multidisciplinary higher education.
strings.timeline.t5.title: SSN engineering college founded
strings.timeline.t5.text: Established the Chennai college named for his father, expanding his educational institutions.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Foundation established
strings.timeline.t6.text: Created the Shiv Nadar Foundation with education and leadership development as its focus.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Cofounded HCL
strings.timeline.t7.text: Established a computer business with career associates; it later became a global IT group.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed engineering education
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned an electrical-engineering degree at PSG before entering engineering and management work.
